items.title: Australia: Cash rate target, 5 November 2026
items.content_text: New data: In Australia, the Reserve Bank of Australia's cash rate target was 4.85% on 5 November 2026, up from 4.60% on 3 November 2026. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia. Source: Reserve Bank of Australia (https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/cash-rate/).
